description: B holds 20 rows. (a) Dynaset D1 at row 1 and nothing else read: db.Execute DELETE FROM B WHERE ID IN (3,4) (dbFailOnError); GetRows(6), read BOF, EOF and ID; GetRows(6) again, read. (b) Dynaset D2 at row 1: db.Execute DELETE FROM B WHERE ID IN (9,10); Move 8 and read; MoveFirst; GetRows(6), read; GetRows(6), read; GetRows(6), read. (c) Dynaset D3: Move 11 (ID 12 as listed before the deletions), read, db.Execute DELETE FROM B WHERE ID = 12, GetRows(2), read, GetRows(2), read. (d) Snapshot S: db.Execute DELETE FROM B WHERE ID = 15 after opening, GetRows(20), read. Asks whether a deletion made elsewhere is skipped, returned or fatal inside GetRows when it was undiscovered, discovered or on the current row, the short-return frontier and the dynaset against the snapshot. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
